newsitem.title: USA: GenRad Inc unit wins contract with Ford.
newsitem.headline: GenRad Inc unit wins contract with Ford.

text.p: GenRad Inc said Monday that Ford Motor Co has selected its Advanced Diagnostic Solutions division as the full-service supplier for Ford's new Worldwide Diagnostic System.

GenRad said it will supply software development tools, diagnostic applications engineering and tester hardware systems for distribution throughout the world to the Ford, Lincoln-Mercury, Jaguar and Aston-Martin dealerships.
GenRad said that at the request of the client company, unit prices have not been disclosed, but that it is a "multi-million dollar" contract.

Advanced Diagnostic Solutions, in Stockport, England, supplies diagnostic and information solutions for electrical and electronic systems in the automotive, aerospace, agricultural and construction industries.
